entries.text: Good morning, Mr. Jacq!
entries.label: common_0240_student_06

entries.text: Hello, hello, everyone.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: common_0240_teacher_00

entries.text: We have some exciting news this morning. Who\nwants to hear it?[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: common_0240_teacher_01

entries.text: Oooh oooh! Me! I want to hear the news!
entries.label: common_0240_student_07

entries.text: I suppose I should have told you sooner, but\nwe have a new little friend joining our happy\r\nhomeroom as of today.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: common_0240_teacher_02

entries.text: *whisper whisper whisper*
entries.label: common_0240_student_01

entries.text: I wonder what they’ll be like?
entries.label: common_0240_student_02

entries.text: All right! You can come on in![VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: common_0240_teacher_03

entries.text: Could I trouble you for a few words introducing\nyourself?[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: common_0240_teacher_04

entries.text: Did you hear that? [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0201)]HShe seems super friendly\nand fun!
entries.label: common_0240_student_03a

entries.text: So calm and collected! [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0201)]HShe’s pretty cool!
entries.label: common_0240_student_03b

entries.text: Looks like everyone’s eager to get to know you,\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)].[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: common_0240_teacher_05

entries.text: All right, then. Who wants to be the first to ask\nour new friend a question?[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

entries.text: Me! Me! Can I ask a question?!
entries.label: common_0240_student_m_01

entries.text: What’s your favorite thing about Pokémon?
entries.label: common_0240_student_m_02

entries.text: I like battling with Pokémon
entries.label: common_0240_select_06

entries.text: I like collecting Pokémon
entries.label: common_0240_select_07

entries.text: I like playing with my Pokémon
entries.label: common_0240_select_08

entries.text: I like everything about Pokémon!
entries.label: common_0240_select_14

entries.text: Really? Awesome! I’m totally the same!
entries.label: common_0240_student_m_03

entries.text: Does anyone else have a question for their\nnew classmate?[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: common_0240_teacher_07

entries.text: Me! I have a question![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0240_rival_01

entries.text: You went to all the trouble of enrolling here, so\nspill, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]...[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0240_rival_02

entries.text: What do you hope to get out of it? You must\nhave some kind of dream, right?[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0240_rival_03

entries.text: I want to complete the Pokédex
entries.label: common_0240_select_09

entries.text: I want to be a strong Trainer
entries.label: common_0240_select_10

entries.text: I don’t actually know
entries.label: common_0240_select_11

entries.text: I’m glad I got you set up with that Pokédex app if\nyou like collecting that much![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0240_rival_03a

entries.text: You will be! Oh, I just know it! You and me—\nwe’re going to get so strong battling together![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0240_rival_03b

entries.text: Fair, I get it! The possibilities are endless, right?\nWho can decide![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0240_rival_03c

entries.text:
Well, thank you for telling us a bit about
yourself, [VAR 0x0100(0000)].\c
I’m Mr. Jacq. I teach biology here at the
academy, and I’m also your homeroom teacher.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: common_0240_teacher_08

entries.text: That’s your seat. Second row from the front.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: common_0240_teacher_09

entries.text: All right, you ragamuffins. Be nice and friendly\nto our new classmate![VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: common_0240_teacher_10

entries.text: We will, Mr. Jacq!
entries.label: common_0240_student_05

entries.text: Get to know the academy campus by exploring a\nbit on your own!
entries.label: common_0240_system_01

entries.text: Yo, new kid! Glad to have you!
entries.label: common_0240_student_m_a

entries.text: When class is in session, we tend to be on our\nbest behavior. But our best still isn’t that good!
entries.label: common_0240_student_m_b

entries.text: Wh-what, you want to talk to me?!
entries.label: common_0240_student_m_c

entries.text: Thanks for answering my question earlier!
entries.label: common_0240_student_f_a

entries.text: Welcome to the academy!
